name: Accelerated Training for 3DGS
definition: A strategy to improve training time efficiency by separating higher SH bands from the 0th band within the rasterizer, reducing the number of updates for higher SH bands compared to diffused colors.
summary: Accelerated Training for 3DGS improves training efficiency by decoupling higher spherical harmonic bands from the base color, updating them less frequently to reduce computational load.
